messages:
mina: Idea: add a "preview cohort" mode for runtime config changes. Instead of a pct split across everyone, pick stable hash buckets (cohort) and shadow/compare outputs + cost.
rob: cohort = stable user buckets makes sense. advantage: deterministic replay later. what fields do we need in the manifest?
mina: minimal manifest: snapshot_id, cohort_name, buckets[], duration, sampling (0-100), etag, created_by. router will check cohort membership then fork to shadow path.
joy: telemetry checklist: divergence_score, latency_delta, token_delta, error_rate. we should compute an aggregated safety_score (0-100). default auto-hold if safety_score < 70.
lucas: important: per-tenant caps. small tenants must not be exposed if projected daily cost delta > tenant_cap ($ or %). exclude them by default unless explicitly opted-in.
rob: API helpers: `X-RI-Cohort: ops-beta` to force membership, `X-RI-Preview: snap-20240601-7` to fetch snapshot in dev. Also CLI: `rictl snapshot create --from=live --cohort=ops-beta --duration=1h`.
ops-bot: preflight: manifest validated, buckets non-empty, etag present, safety caps defined.
joy: replay idea: router emits `intended_target` + `shadow_outcome` in logs. replay tool can re-run recorded events against other snapshots. CLI: `rictl replay --snapshot snap-7 --since 1h`
lucas: for cost use offline token estimator (no live billing). also add a blast_cap: percent of combined daily token budget; if projected cost delta > blast_cap -> auto-block.
mina: UX in console: show cohort membership, live vs shadow QPS, safety_score sparkline, estimated cost delta, and a Promote -> phased rollout button (0.1% -> 1% -> 10% -> 100%). show next-step ETA and pass/fail reason.
rob: snapshot immutability: snapshot blob immutable; manifest can change traffic_pct/ttl only. audit fields: applied_by, created_at, change_reason.
joy: closed-loop eval fallback: if shadowing too heavy, run representative prompt set (N=200) every 10m and compare scores. annotate cache_hit metric so we don't confuse cache improvements with model changes.
lucas: rollback playbook: immediate rollback triggers: cost_delta > blast_cap, critical error rate >= 1%, eval regression > 5 points. manual roll forward requires two admins.
mina: edge case: model variant differences (quantized weights, kernel path). label snapshots that require non-reproducible env and run closed-loop eval instead of shadowing.
rob: can we support dry-run mode that logs intended routing but doesn't fork? router would add `intended_target` field for ops to replay against recorded events.
joy: automation step: after X minutes of cohort shadowing, run auto-checks: safety_score >= 80, cost_delta < 3%, 95p latency delta < 50ms -> mark ok_for_weighted_rollout.
ops-bot: scheduled sync: eng-platform Friday 10:30am (invite sent).
mina: next: rob prototype router hooks + header, joy to draft telemetry dashboard, lucas to write tenant cap rules and rollback thresholds. I'll wire console mock.
rob: will open a small PR for router changes.
joy: will add dashboard placeholders and alert rules.
lucas: putting thresholds into my board.
ops-bot: checklist updated: prototype PR, telemetry dashboard placeholder, console mock referenced.
